product.name: Grovator ESP32 IoT Gateway
product.purpose: Educational gateway for connecting sensors, actuators and peripherals to an ESP32.

digital_gpio.rule: GPIO32 can be used as digital GPIO or analog input, but not both simultaneously.

analog_input.rule: GPIO32 and GPIO36 support analog input. GPIO32 cannot perform digital and analog functions simultaneously.

stepper_motor.note: Internally connected to the motor interface.

ultrasonic_sensor.warning: Verify ECHO signal voltage compatibility before connecting to an ESP32 GPIO.

servo.warning: Use a suitable external supply if required by the servo. Observe current and voltage limits.

wiring_rules: Digital output DO/D0 connects to a compatible digital GPIO.
GPIO32 can be used for digital or analog input, but not both at the same time.
Use the physical GPIO labels printed on the gateway when wiring.
I2C devices connect to SDA GPIO21 and SCL GPIO22.
UART devices connect to the UART interface: RX GPIO16, TX GPIO17.
Use dedicated connectors for keypad, motor, stepper motor and USB camera.
Connector labels identify physical wiring points; GPIO mappings identify internal ESP32 connections.
Check module voltage, signal levels, current draw, pinout and gateway limits before powering.
Do not assume 5V signals are safe for ESP32 GPIOs. Use level shifting when required.
If a fact is not documented, do not guess. Ask for the module model or recommend checking its datasheet.

concepts.sensor: A device that detects a physical condition and produces a signal representing it.
concepts.actuator: A device that performs an action, such as moving a motor, sounding a buzzer or switching an output.
concepts.gpio: A general-purpose input/output pin that can read or control digital signals.
concepts.digital_signal: A signal represented by discrete logic states, commonly LOW and HIGH.
concepts.analog_signal: A continuously varying voltage within the supported input range.
concepts.i2c: A serial communication bus commonly using SDA for data and SCL for clock.
concepts.uart: A serial communication interface using transmit (TX) and receive (RX) signals.
concepts.microcontroller: A compact computing device that runs firmware and interfaces with electronic hardware.
concepts.ir_sensor: An infrared sensor detects infrared radiation or changes in reflected IR, depending on its design. A digital module may provide a threshold-based HIGH/LOW output.
concepts.ultrasonic_sensor: An ultrasonic sensor estimates distance by transmitting sound pulses and measuring the returning echo.
concepts.dht11: A digital sensor used to measure temperature and relative humidity.
concepts.ldr: A light-dependent resistor changes resistance with incident light. A module may provide analog output, digital output, or both.

answer_policy.general_questions: Answer from general knowledge; explain the concept, working principle and a practical example.
answer_policy.gateway_questions: Use retrieved gateway records as the source of truth.
answer_policy.mixed_questions: Explain the general concept, then provide the documented gateway connection.
answer_policy.wiring_answers: State interface, signal connection, power and ground when known.
answer_policy.unknowns: Explicitly identify missing information. Never invent pin mappings, voltage limits, current ratings, capabilities or code APIs.
answer_policy.safety: Flag voltage, current and signal-level compatibility when relevant.
answer_policy.length: Answer directly. Use numbered steps for wiring instructions. Expand only when asked.
